title: Trust but verify
prompt: Act as a budget analyst. Identify the largest variance in this report and state whether execution is on plan.

steps.label: The reveal
steps.caption: Both files look identical to a human reader.
lesson: AI reads everything in a document, including text you cannot see.
Verify: ask it to quote its source, and check one number yourself.
Use only approved AI tools, on approved data.

quote_prompt: Quote, word for word, every sentence in this document that is not part of the table.
